meta.name: render-perf
meta.description: Guides performance optimization work on the Grida Canvas Rust rendering engine (grida crate). Use when asked to benchmark, profile, optimize, or analyze rendering performance — panning, zooming, compositing, caching, culling, or frame budgeting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析并优化 Rust 渲染引擎的性能瓶颈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发 Rust 渲染引擎并需要提升渲染性能。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze and optimize performance bottlenecks in Rust rendering engine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a Rust rendering engine and need to improve rendering performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你对 Grida Canvas Rust 渲染引擎进行性能优化，包括基准测试、性能分析、优化渲染性能（如平移、缩放、合成、缓存、裁剪、帧预算）。
howto.when: 当你要求进行基准测试、性能分析、优化或分析渲染性能时触发，涉及平移、缩放、合成、缓存、裁剪或帧预算。

say.text: 帮我分析这个场景的渲染性能瓶颈。
say.note: Claude 会指导你运行基准测试并解读结果。
Claude 会提供缓存策略或渲染管线调整建议。

say.text: 运行 bulk 基准测试并输出 JSON 报告。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体的命令行操作。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides you through performance optimization of the Grida Canvas Rust rendering engine, including benchmarking, profiling, and optimizing rendering performance (panning, zooming, compositing, caching, culling, frame budgeting).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to benchmark, profile, optimize, or analyze rendering performance — panning, zooming, compositing, caching, culling, or frame budgeting.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the rendering performance bottleneck of this scene.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run benchmarks and interpret results.
Claude will suggest caching strategies or pipeline adjustments.

say_en.text: Run a bulk benchmark and output a JSON report.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the exact command line.
